purpose: Per-item review evidence for the 120 preservation differences that run 42732552451 (rolling 39) reported as review_required. Approval is granted per exact difference ID; there is no wildcard or category-wide approval.
verification_method: Difference IDs were read verbatim from reports/preservation-image.json in the run artifact and re-checked as an exact set: 120 of 120, no substitutions.

Each file_sha256 / added_file item was attributed to its owning package through the image apk database (/lib/apk/packages/*.list), and image bytes were re-hashed from inspection/rootfs.squashfs to reproduce the reported actual sha256.
Owning package versions were compared with ci/baseline/original-package-manifest.json (expected) and inspection/installed-packages.json (image).
Files whose owning package version did not move were compared byte-for-byte with the pinned upstream source at the locked feed commit 4956879a.
Generated apk metadata was explained from its generating inputs: world version pins and the package file list.
